name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A default single-open accordion of three FAQ-style items with height-animated open/close and a plus icon that rotates 45 degrees into an X while its panel is open.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no value props; Accordion.Root manages single-open state internally with all panels initially closed
nonTrivialInteractions: Height-animated open/close: each Panel sizes itself with the --accordion-panel-height custom property and collapses via data-starting-style/data-ending-style h-0 transitions
Trigger is a group whose PlusIcon rotates 45 degrees when the panel is open via the group-data-panel-open variant
Hover highlight skips disabled triggers via hover:not-data-disabled:bg-neutral-100, and triggers show a focus-visible outline ring

name: hidden-until-found
whatItDemonstrates: A shipping-FAQ accordion with hiddenUntilFound set once on Root, so closed panels stay mounted with hidden="until-found" and browser find-in-page (e.g. searching "restocking") reveals the matching panel.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no value props; Accordion.Root manages single-open state internally with all panels initially closed
nonTrivialInteractions: Root-level hiddenUntilFound applies to all panels: closed panels remain in the DOM with hidden="until-found" instead of being unmounted
Closed panel contents such as the "restocking fee" text in the second panel remain searchable by browser find-in-page
Same height animation and rotating plus icon treatment as the hero demo

name: multiple
whatItDemonstrates: The hero FAQ accordion with multiple set on Root, so several panels can be open at the same time.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — Root gets the multiple prop and manages per-item open state internally with no React state in the demo
nonTrivialInteractions: Multiple panels stay open simultaneously; toggling one item does not close the others
Same height animation and rotating plus icon treatment as the hero demo
